trial_court: Court of learned Additional Senior Civil Judge, Eluru (C.R.P.No.190 of 2019)
case_name: Vankadaru Jyothiratna Sowdamini vs Vankadaru Rama Krishna

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: wife, seeking to set aside amendment to divorce petition
parties.respondent_defendant: husband, seeking to amend divorce petition to include adultery as ground for divorce

facts_of_case: Petitioner is wife of respondent, who filed divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act against her on grounds of cruelty and desertion. Respondent sought to amend petition to include adultery as ground for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A respondent cannot set up a new ground altogether changing the character and nature of the main petition without initially setting it up in the main petition.
legal_principles.held: It is further contended that the proposed amendment is setting up a new ground altogether changing the very character and nature of the main divorce petition.

legal_principles.principle: A court should not consider the merits of an amendment application.
legal_principles.held: Thus, mainly stating and that the proposed amendment would drastically affect the defence of the petitioner, it is requested to allow this revision petition.
